description:
SURFACE: /settings/tasks assignment -> /files (SESSION column) -> bulk export dialog.

WHAT BREAKS: Tasks authored at /settings/tasks and assigned through the speaker picker produce deliverables with no session linkage. The deliverables dashboard shows '- no session attached' for both speakers, including for a speaker who has exactly one session, and an uploaded slides.pdf still reads 'No session - Priya Raman' in the bulk-export dialog. Consequence is functional, not cosmetic: the export dialog's DEFAULT grouping is 'Group files by Session - One folder per session', and it cannot place these files. Fixture tasks in the same table DO carry sessions, so the association exists as a concept and is simply not established on this path.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed at live sha 75b871d94c6f) -- the backend already supports this; the UI path does not use it:
- src/routes/files.queries.ts:162 -> session: task.submission_id ? { id, title } : null   (the SESSION column is driven entirely by task.submission_id)
- src/routes/task-templates.routes.ts:95 -> submission_id: z.string().min(1).nullable().optional()  -- accepted on assignment
- src/routes/task-templates.routes.ts:634-638 -> validated against the conference when supplied
- src/routes/task-templates.routes.ts:647 -> submissionId: body.submission_id ?? null  -- silently null when the UI omits it
So the assignment UI never sends submission_id and the row is created unattached.

FIX SHAPE: offer a session picker in the assignment flow; auto-attach when the speaker has exactly one session; and make grouped export state what it could not place rather than silently dropping it.

SIZE: medium.

PROVENANCE: sbek run 2026-08-12T15-33-34, content-management judgement, defects[0]. Validated by reading live source.
title: File-request tasks assigned via the speaker picker lose their session, breaking grouped export
